title: Head Study in Watercolor
content: Head of a Woman(1893) by Julian Fałat (Polish:1853-1929), watercolor on paper, National Museum, WarsawJulian Falat studied in Kraków and Munich. He used to say:"Polish art ought to convey our history and our beliefs, our qualities as well as our defects; it must be the quintessence of our soil, our sky, and our ideals."
